releaseNotes:
OmniControl Suite v8.12.1 - EcoQoS Background Throttling & Proactive Anti-Heat:
- Windows 11 EcoQoS Efficiency Mode integration for background apps (browsers, Discord, Spotify).
- Lowered thermal setpoints for proactive gentle airflow cooling (prevents heatsink heatsoak).
- Automatic idle core parking and CPPC2 dynamic voltage scaling.
- Strict TempTamer enforcement across all 3D and gaming contexts.
